summary: Astro Care is an immersive 30-Sol Martian survival strategy game developed by Team Lyra V. We developed a data-driven habitat management simulator where players command a specialist crew, balance six life-support resource gauges, and navigate 30 real-world space weather events using live space telemetry, an adaptive Super Intelligence (Astro-Bot SI) assistant, and immersive physiological audio. It addresses the challenge of inaccessible scientific data by transforming dense, dry public telemetry from NASA and the Canadian Space Agency into an interactive, gamified learning experience designed for players aged 12 and above. This is important because it converts complex orbital physics, radiation dosimetry, and space agriculture into an accessible educational tool that promotes critical decision-making under pressure and fosters deep awareness of open science.
details:
Astro Care, developed by Team Lyra V, is an electrifying 30-Sol Martian survival strategy game that turns complex, dry space telemetry into an adrenaline-fueled interstellar adventure. Players command a specialist crew, outsmart real-time space weather anomalies, and masterfully balance six life-support resource gauges, all while being guided by an adaptive Astro-Bot SI assistant.

Built using Godot Engine 4 with live NASA and CSA telemetry integration, robust offline fallback capabilities, and multi-channel physiological audio, the project bridges the vast gap between elite space research and the public. It makes complex orbital physics, radiation dosimetry, and space agriculture uniquely intuitive and deeply engaging for players aged 12 and above, serving as a powerful, hands-on STEM learning tool. Featuring a 100% hand-crafted 30-event narrative matrix, bespoke pixel-art assets, and dynamic emotional AI moods, Team Lyra V carefully prioritized flawless offline stability, clean code modularity, responsive UI/UX, and accessible STEM education to deliver an unforgettable mission on the red frontier.
